name: noibu
description: Analyze ecommerce conversion, shopper behavior, errors, and experiments using Noibu data.

interface.longDescription: Connect Noibu to analyze store health, checkout, products, traffic segments, technical issues, and A/B opportunities. Includes native in-chat KPI/funnel and priority-board templates with investigation, save, export, schedule, context-approval, and selected A/B draft actions through ChatGPT. Save as Live Site publishes the verified report into a private Site with durable snapshot history; live data connections and scheduled updates are separate options requiring their own verification. Technical, accessibility, performance and implementation fixes reuse GitHub or prompt connection and repository selection; source writes and PRs need separate authorization. Missing visualization or host-action support falls back to useful reports and copyable requests. Analytics and requested drafts use the remote MCP connection. Browser accessibility auditing uses bundled axe-core with approved desktop/Chrome execution and returns findings directly without a server reader. Visual previews are optional and their omission is explained. Native scheduled reports, Site publishing, repository changes, and external delivery require the actual available tools and appropriate authorization.
defaultPrompt: How is my store doing in the last 24 hours?
Compare checkout performance with the previous 30 days.
Find evidence-backed A/B tests to improve add-to-cart rate.
